name: bank_security_alert
description: Caller impersonates a bank's fraud or security department. Claims the account has been compromised. Requests OTP, card number, or a fund transfer to a 'safe account'.

name: irs_tax_authority_scam
description: Caller impersonates the IRS, tax authority, or government agency. Threatens arrest, lawsuit, or asset seizure. Demands immediate payment via gift card or wire.

name: tech_support_scam
description: Caller claims to be from Microsoft, Apple, or another tech company. States the victim's device is infected. Asks for remote access or payment for fake software.

name: lottery_prize_scam
description: Caller informs the victim they have won a lottery, prize, or sweepstakes. Requests an upfront fee or personal details to claim the prize.

name: advance_fee_fraud
description: Caller offers a large sum of money (inheritance, investment, contract) in exchange for an upfront fee, tax, or legal cost.

name: utility_cutoff_scam
description: Caller impersonates a utility company (electricity, gas, water). Claims payment is overdue and service will be cut off immediately. Demands gift card or wire payment.

name: romance_scam
description: Caller or contact has built a romantic relationship over time and now requests money for an emergency: medical bills, travel, or business.

name: robocall_spam
description: Automated or semi-automated unsolicited marketing call. Not necessarily fraudulent but violates consent.
